# Kaleidocycle diagnostic fixture

This is the tracked fixture entry alongside `pocketmod8` and `cootie_catcher`.
`expected.json` records semantic invariants. The 32-panel vector sources and
two impositions are generated by `scripts/generate_kaleidocycle_orientation_fixture.py`
rather than checked in as repeated SVGs. Existing cootie fixtures use the same
generated-source approach for their semantic orientation diagnostic.

Default generated location: `output/hardware-acceptance/kaleidocycle/`.
Instructions: [physical orientation diagnostics](../../../../docs/validation/kaleidocycle-orientation-fixture.md).
Physical inspection and its uploaded pack: [HAR-179](https://linear.app/hardcase/issue/HAR-179/physically-inspect-kaleidocycle-diagnostic-plots).

The Linear Resources attachment is independent of local output. Keep it and
existing proofs; reorganizing this fixture does not validate the provisional
assembled profiles or replace physical observations.
